name: Nameless Stranger (Arcane Archer)
body:
The nameless stranger is an expert of both magic and firearms, bringing arcane justice on the point of a bullet.

Requirements

To qualify to become a nameless stranger, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Base Attack Bonus: +6.
Feats: Exotic Weapon Proficiency (firearms), Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Weapon Focus (any one-handed or two-handed firearm).
Spellcasting Ability to cast 1stlevel arcane spells.

This alters requirements.

Features
Class Skills

The nameless stranger’s class skills (and the key ability for each skill) are Perception (Wis), Ride (Dex), Sleight of Hand (Dex), and Survival (Wis).

This alters class skills.

Arcane Bullets (Su)

A nameless stranger selects one firearm he is wielding to fire magical bullets. Only one firearm at a time can benefit from this ability. Arcane bullets can receive the benefits of the enhance arrows, imbue arrow, seeker arrow, phase arrow, hail of harrows, and arrow of death abilities as if they were arrows. At 3rd level, the nameless stranger adds thundering to the list of abilities he can add to his bullets; at 7th level, he adds sonic boom to the list too.
